children: Italy posted a trade surplus with the rest of the world of €8.240 billion ($9.51 billion) in July, compared with a surplus of €7.829 billion in the same month of 2025, data showed on Tuesday.
Exports rose 4.7% year-on-year, while imports increased 4.6%, national statistics office ISTAT reported.
With European Union countries, Italy registered a July trade surplus of €1.251 billion, compared with a surplus of €1.834 billion in 2025.
Exports to EU nations in July were up 2.7% year-on-year, compared to a rise of 4.9% in imports.
